summary: Warm Gateway interpretation port for Chantier 1: Gemini free first, Luna on technical failure only, through api.runtime.llm.complete.
reason: Amine's 23/10 decision (doc 71): one interpreter for every surface and domain within 2 s; per-turn agent exec took 22 s and could not use the Gateway-owned OpenAI OAuth.

tests.name: openclaw-plugin-mobile-ui/scripts/test-intent-interpreter-port.cjs
tests.evidence: Gemini-only success; Luna with OAuth on each technical code and on unparsable output; no Luna on authorization refusal; both-down unavailable; timeout abort hands the remaining budget to Luna; closed outcomes; request limits; handler codes; config patch limited to two models.

capabilities.reason: Internal Gateway method with operator.write scope; no new capability route; no caller wired yet.

architecture.reason: Adds the single interpretation port of doc 71 on the existing OpenClaw plugin LLM runtime; replaces per-turn agent exec for interpretation in later steps. No new store, registry, router, scheduler or daemon.

rollback: Revert this PR and remove plugins.entries.openclaw-plugin-mobile-ui.llm with the OpenClaw configuration owner; no durable state is owned by the port.
limitations: Real latency p50/p95 is measured after deployment with openclaw gateway call; fake-runtime tests do not prove provider behavior.
responseFormat mapping depends on the provider transport; decisions are parsed strictly in any case.
